title: Store Catalog
description: One declaration per governed store: where it lives, who holds custody of its records (information asset scope model: system / tenant / person), which tiers it may hold and which legacy store roles touch it today. G0 of the store-catalog guard design records current behaviour only; tier-guard does not read it yet. Stores whose custodian cannot be determined from their path are declared unscoped-legacy instead of guessed (scope model R-01).

path.description: Repo-relative path template. Placeholders: <tier> (personal|confidential|public), <tenant> (tenant slug or the literal shared segment), <customer>, <slug> (stance slug), <id> (one record id).

ref.description: Placeholder in path that names the custodian (tenant: <tenant>; person: installation-owner until per-person partitions exist).

shared_segment.description: Custody of the literal shared partition segment (records with no tenant).

status.description: planned: the new home a migration (S1-S3) fills; legacy-move: today's location that a migration empties.

moves_to.description: Store id that replaces a legacy-move store.

legacy_roles.description: Store-scoped authority roles whose security-policy paths reach this store today (G2 replaces them with grants).
